title: CSM orchestrate suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority execution preferences for the csm-orchestrate namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only default dispatch timing and bounded parallelism are configurable; host selection, capability grants, approvals, gates, trust roots, remediation budgets, and autonomy are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

defaultTimeoutMs.description: Default per-invocation timeout in milliseconds; a bounded ceiling only, never a safety-limit or host-policy change.

maxParallelism.description: Maximum number of concurrently dispatched independent read-only route nodes; never changes approvals, capabilities, or write routing.
